Sufas (also known as malar bags or malar edema) are swelling in the upper cheek area — just below the lower eyelids and above the nasolabial folds.

Main cause:
They form due to stagnation of lymph and venous blood in the midface. This can happen when:
• cheek and eye area muscles are chronically tight
• lymphatic flow is blocked
• posture is off — affecting fluid circulation
• there’s chronic puffiness or sinus congestion
• soft tissues lose tone and begin to “slide”

✨ Important:
You can’t just cover them with concealer or “fill” them with injections.

To truly reduce sufas, you need to work with the root causes — strengthen weak facial muscles , relax overworked, + neck work of course!
